recipes.title: Apple and Oat Crumble
recipes.description: Soft cinnamon apples under a crisp oat topping.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 190°C. Peel and slice the apples, then toss them with the cinnamon in a baking dish.
Rub the butter into the flour. Stir in the oats and sugar, then scatter the mixture over the apples.
Bake until the topping is golden and the apples are tender.

recipes.notes: Serve warm with plain yoghurt, custard or ice cream.
